content.rendered: Did you miss picture day or want to take a new picture?  Dorian Studios will be here on November 8th, 8:15-10:30am, for picture retakes.  If you are needing retakes, please bring in your picture packet on this day.  See the flyer for more details, including how to order online.  Envelopes are available in the office if needed.
